sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Jai Prakash Singh,Raj Kiran Chaudhary Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants Gagan Soni & Neelam Soni with a prayer to release them on bail in Case Crime No.415 of 2021, under Sections 406, 417, 419,
420, 467, 468, 471, 473, 504, 506, 120-B I.P.C., P.S. Sigra, District Varanasi during pendency of the trial.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.
Applicants are not named in the FIR.
Applicants' name surfaced in the statement of one co-accused Rajiv Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gutpa.

entities.text: Rajiv Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gutpa
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: Co-accused Rajiv Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gupta was implicated in the present case by co-accused Vishal Sharma.

entities.text: Rajiv Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gupta
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants next submitted that co-accused Jasveer Kaur, Rajeev Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gupta, Anshu Kumar Gupta @ Laloo & Vishal Sharma have been granted bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 4.2.2022, 11.03.2022,
18.02.2022 & 11.10.2022.

entities.text: Rajeev Kumar Gupta @ Raju Kumar Gupta
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants next submits that the applicants Gagan Soni And Another vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151958048/
1 having better case for getting bail on account of parity.

entities.text: Gagan Soni And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next argued that no offence under NRI Act has been lodged against the applicant.
There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicants are not a previous convict.
The applicants are languishing in jail since 18.09.2022 and in case they are enlarged on bail they will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicants but could not dispute the facts narrated by counsel for the applicants and parity claimed with co-accused, who have been granted bail.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicants, Gagan Soni & Neelam Soni, who are involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicants shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
